deploy-bot: Deploy started to dev environment
Environment: dev
Commit: 7a9c3f2 (tag: v1.14.2-dev)
Pipeline: release/dev-deploy
Change window: rolling
ETA: ~4m

sara.r: On it, watching smoke tests.

mike.p: Any pin for kernel/quantization changes? last dev deploy caused qkernel mismatch before.

sara.r: No kernel pin this time, just model-serving changes. If we see >1% 5xx we'll rollback.

karen.oncall: Reminder: change window overlaps with load test at 21:00 UTC. prefer hold until 21:15.

deploy-bot: Hold engaged. Queue position 1. Starting preflight checks...

ci-bot: Smoke tests: step1 ok, step2 ok, step3 warn: minor cache miss rate increased (2.1%)

sara.r: Noted. Acceptable for dev. Proceed with canary 10% then rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary 10% -> success. Metrics: p95 latency +8ms, error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.09%). Rolling to 50%.

mike.p: Seeing a few OOM traces on node gpu-3 in logs:
```
OOM kill: process llm-server pid=2345 vmrss=13.2G
stack: ...
```
Can we pin to previous commit if it spikes?

sara.r: If OOMs exceed 3 instances or error rate >0.5% we rollback. Rollback command:
`deploybot rollback --env dev --to-tag v1.14.1`

deploy-bot: Rollout to 50% complete. No new OOMs observed in last 2m. Continuing to 100%.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: success
Release: v1.14.2-dev
Rollout: 100%
Smoke summary: 12/12 checks passed, cache miss elevated but within dev tolerances
Logs: https://internal.logs/release/2159876543
:party-parrot:

karen.oncall: Will keep monitoring for 30m. File a postmortem if any persistent OOMs.

sara.r: Opened ticket INF-3287 to track cache miss spikes and GPU OOM traces. Tagging mike.

mike.p: Ack. I'll attach heap profiles if it recurs.

ci-bot: Auto-notify: changelog generated at https://git/repo/compare/v1.14.1...v1.14.2 (notes: internal perf improvements, autoscaler tweak)
